name: outcome-learning
description: Outcome/post-mortem learning (W053, the W035–W052 flat source-exported package pattern): the OUTCOME layer over completed evaluations. postmortem.ts is THE GATE derivePostMortem: the completed evaluation (W038's ExperimentEvaluation + its verification FindingsReport) re-proven through W038's own laws (the evaluation id re-derived from the record's own carried bytes, the findings digest re-derived through verification's own machinery), the split family re-proven through W052's own validateSplitFamily, the search history through W051's own validateSearchHistory (errors carried verbatim), scope agreement proven across all three — then the PostMortem sealed: content-addressed pm-<digest> id, the predicted-vs-happened comparison CARRIED from the evaluation's own holdout aggregations (never re-scored), the family + history citations, the explicit scope, immutable lineage, deterministic provenance. lessons.ts derives the typed LESSONS (failure-mode taxonomy as a closed set, capability deltas, held-out-vs-train divergence signals — ALL carried statistics of the evaluation's own data, canonical-id ordered); an uncited lesson is a loud typed refusal naming A6/R052. validate.ts re-validates whole records from recorded data. A14: composes typed records — never trains, never improves anything (W055), no firm brain (W054).
